operating_notes.text: Vehicle Finance AUM ₹1,19,558 Cr (+18% YoY) with Q4FY26 NIM at 8.7% and loan losses at 1.6% of assets.
Gold loan book grew to ₹1,804 Cr in FY26 from ₹573 Cr, with Stage 3 at 0.02%.
Branch network at 1,761 across 26 states and 7 union territories, 88% in Tier-III to Tier-VI towns.
Q4 FY26 disbursements reached ₹32,913 Cr (+25% YoY), taking total AUM to ₹2,42,630 Cr (+21% YoY).
Gold loan per-branch AUM is ₹12-15 Cr; 90% of gold loan customers are new to Chola and yields are ~16-17%, on par with peers.
CSEL net credit cost fell to 4.7% from 6.7% and pretax ROA is 3.3%; SBPL pretax ROA is 7.9% with Stage 3 at 2.3%.
Collections employ around 30,000 people; 55% of CSEL collections are digital.
All 2,00,000 Compulsorily Convertible Debentures (CCDs) were converted into 1,42,83,916 equity shares as of September 30, 2026.
The company transferred stressed loans (NPA) of ₹85.34 Cr to ARCs during the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
85% of branch locations are in Tier-III to Tier-VI towns.
Gold loan branches increased to 308 by September 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹8,416.71 Cr (+19.5% YoY), net profit ₹1,645.2 Cr (+30.6% YoY).
FY26 investor presentation: AUM ₹2.42 lakh Cr (+21%), PAT ₹5,220 Cr (+23%), Stage 3 3.05%, CAR 19.21%.
Cholamandalam Investment and Finance reported Q4 FY26 AUM growth of 21% to ₹2,42,630 Cr and held an earnings call.
Chola's Q1FY27 call (28 July 2026) reported AUM up 23% to ₹2,54,392 Cr, net credit cost at the 1.5% FY27 target already, and guided 23% AUM growth for the year.
Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited schedules earnings call on 28-Oct-2026 at 16:00 IST to discuss Q3FY27 performance via Kotak Institutional Equities.
Cholamandalam Finance approved a ₹5,000 Cr QIP and reported in Q2 consolidated PAT at ₹1,630 Cr.
Chola Finance reported a 41% YoY rise in Q2 PAT to ₹1,630 Cr and converted 2,00,000 CCDs into equity shares.

watchlist.response: Kundu said net credit cost already fell to 1.5% from 1.8% and the Stage 3 rise is seasonal, smaller than last year's Q4-to-Q1 jump.
watchlist.text: Stage 3 rose across most segments except CSEL; risk to 1.5% credit cost guidance

watchlist.response: Attributed to the shift to recognising disbursements on cheque clearance; home loan interest income rose to 15.9% from 15.5% for the year.
watchlist.text: Home loan yields down ~60 bps QoQ

watchlist.response: Kundu declined a number, saying 3.5% is a minimum and they will try to hold or improve it.
Arul Selvan declined to comment without seeing the circular.
